title: trace-v1 manifest
description: manifest.json of a trace-v1 directory (lab-ui PRD S5). Identity, provenance and the block table of neural.trace. lab-ui refuses to open a manifest that fails this schema (PRD S5, 'Rules').

magic.description: Fixed marker identifying this file as a trace-v1 manifest. Any other value means the reader is looking at the wrong contract version.

schema_version.description: Version of this JSON schema the manifest was written against. Bumped whenever a field is added, removed or reinterpreted.

endian.description: Byte order of every block in neural.trace and of physical.replay. Universe writes little-endian only (bytemuck::Pod on x86_64/amd64); the field exists so a reader never has to assume it.

run.description: Run directory name as indexed by lab.db (e.g. 'b2_cost_s113'). Identifies which battery/arm/seed produced this trace.

generation.description: Generation index this trace was cut from (0-based, matches the 'gen<NNNN>' the run directory writes, e.g. gen0000.replay, evolve_best_gen0000.bin).

being.description: Population slot index whose sensory/brain/body samples this trace carries. This is the index the recorder calls 'being' in observation.jsonl and 'being_idx' in physical.replay, NOT necessarily the fitness-ranked champion of the generation -- see 'being_selection'.

being_selection.description: Exact criterion used to pick 'being', stated honestly (never assume it is the champion). E.g. 'fixed_population_slot_0 (--vision-being default; not verified to equal the fitness champion for a fresh run without --resume)'. Without this it is possible to display weights from genome.bin (always the generation's evolve_best_gen*.bin) that did not produce the movements shown by this being -- the exact risk PRD S5 warns about.

profile.description: Trace profile from PRD S3: 'summary' = replay + events only (no neural.trace blocks beyond what is listed here); 'champion' = full brain of one being sampled every 2-4 ticks; 'event' = full brain only inside windows around events; 'full' = every tick, requested deliberately.

first_tick.description: Tick number of the first sample in every block of neural.trace (the smallest value in samples_tick).

count.description: Number of samples (T) carried by every block of neural.trace. Equals the length of samples_tick and the first dimension of every block's shape.

stride.description: Nominal tick spacing between consecutive samples (e.g. 16 for a 64 Hz run sampled at 4 Hz). samples_tick is the source of truth for the exact tick of each sample; stride is the nominal/expected spacing used to detect gaps.

samples_tick.description: Explicit tick number of every sample, in order, one entry per row of every block. Length must equal 'count'. Recorded explicitly (not just derived from first_tick+i*stride) because a profile such as 'event' samples irregular windows.

blocks.description: Block table of neural.trace, in the recorder's brain_flow execution order (sensor -> wave -> brain stages -> motor chain -> pose/body). A stage the recorder did not write is listed in 'absent' instead of appearing here. Empty for profile 'summary' (PRD S3: 'replay + events only') -- every block name is then listed in 'absent' instead, each with reason "profile 'summary' carries no neural blocks by design" (S2 deviation from the first cut of this schema, which required minItems 1 here; see src/lab_api/DEVIATIONS.md).

body_schema_version.description: Schema version of the 'body' block's channel layout (see contract/EVENTS.md and the block's 'unit' field for the channel order). Bumped whenever the channel list changes.

brain_schema_version.description: Schema version of the brain-stage blocks (cfc today; l1/l2/intent when the kernels land, per Universe/docs/KERNELS-OBSERVATION-L1L2.md). Bumped whenever a stage's channel layout changes.

hashes.description: sha256 of the source artifacts this trace was produced from, plus of neural.trace itself. The producer refuses to overwrite a trace whose source hashes still match (PRD S5, 'Rules'); a reader can use these to know whether the trace is stale, and 'neural_trace' lets a loader detect a corrupted or truncated neural.trace file before decoding any block from it (PRD S5, validation point 2).

checkpoint.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the genome.bin this trace's checkpoint field points at (the generation's evolve_best_gen<NNNN>.bin).

replay.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the physical.replay file (or of the full gen<NNNN>.replay it was cut from -- state which in the producer's own notes).

config.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the run's launch configuration (the universe_run.py manifest.json for this run directory).

neural_trace.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the entire neural.trace file, whole-file (not per-block). A loader checks this once before trusting any block's offset/length/sha256 in the block table below; a mismatch means the file was corrupted or truncated after the manifest was written.

universe_commit.description: Short git commit hash of the Universe checkout that produced this run's binary (from the run's own manifest.json 'universe_commit').

world_seed.description: World seed recorded in physical.replay's header (ReplayHeader.world_seed, u64 in Rust).

absent.description: Channels/stages/artifacts this trace does NOT carry, each with why. A stage the recorder did not write is absent, never zero-filled (PRD S5, 'Rules').

name.description: Name of the missing block/stage/artifact, e.g. 'l1', 'weights.json', 'track.json'.

reason.description: Why it is missing, stated as fact, e.g. 'not recorded by this binary' or 'produced by S2'.

disabled_flags.description: CLI flags active for this run that disable memory, threshold or heterogeneous activation in the brain (Universe/src/bin/gpu_evolve/cli_flags.rs: --no-neuron-memory, --no-neuron-period, --no-neuron-threshold, --no-heterogeneous-activation). Empty when none of these control-arm flags were set.

recorder_config.description: OPTIONAL (added by S2, not in 'required'; see src/lab_api/DEVIATIONS.md #9 and SCHEMA-CHANGE-recorder_config.md in the neuromod-lab repo). Copies the recorder's own code-path configuration out of driving.meta.json so a panel can tell apart two historically different behaviours that produce the SAME recorded number -- e.g. dist_wall_f == 50.0 means a real 50 m reading on the continuous wall probe but a 'nothing found within reach' sentinel on the legacy stepped probe, whose real reach is only 30 m. A manifest without this object predates S2 or was produced by a producer that has not adopted it yet; treat every field as unknown, not as a specific value, in that case.

wall_probe_kind.description: Same value as 'wall_probes' when known; 'unknown' if driving.meta.json lacked it. Kept as a separate, always-present field so a consumer never has to fall back to a missing 'wall_probes'.

wall_probe_max_m.description: The cap ReplayFrame.dist_wall_f/l/r is clamped to either way (Universe/src/bin/gpu_evolve/wall_probes.rs, the distance(...) call every caller passes 50.0 to). 50.0 in every run measured so far.

wall_probe_reach_m.description: Present only when wall_probe_kind=='legacy': the legacy stepped probe's real reach (30 m). A recorded value >= this is the 'nothing found' sentinel (wall_probe_max_m), not a real distance between this and wall_probe_max_m.

name.description: Block identifier, stable across runs, e.g. 'retina', 'wave', 'cfc', 'raw_intent', 'after_head', 'after_modulation', 'final_command', 'pose', 'body'.

dtype.description: Element type of the raw bytes at [offset, offset+length). Names match JS TypedArray element types (u32 -> Uint32Array, i8 -> Int8Array, f32 -> Float32Array, ...).

shape.description: Logical shape of the decoded array, row-major, first dimension always T (== manifest.count), e.g. [300,14,126] for retina or [300,96] for cfc.

unit.description: Physical unit of a single-channel block (e.g. 'dimensionless'), or, for a multi-channel block whose last dimension packs named scalars, the comma-separated channel names in order (e.g. 'throttle,steer,brake' or 'x_m,z_m,forward_x,forward_z'). The exact channel list per block name is documented in contract/EVENTS.md and contract/DEVIATIONS.md.

scale.description: Multiplicative scale applied to a raw decoded value to obtain the physical quantity named by 'unit'. 1.0 (identity) for every block in schema_version 1, all of which already store physical values in their native dtype without quantization; reserved for a future quantized block.

offset.description: Byte offset of this block's data from the start of neural.trace.

length.description: Byte length of this block's data on disk (post-compression). Equals product(shape) * sizeof(dtype) when compression is 'none'.

compression.description: Compression applied to the block's bytes. Only 'none' exists in schema_version 1; the field is reserved so a future codec does not need a new schema version.

stage.description: Position of this block in the recorder's brain_flow pipeline (e.g. 'sensory_cfc_pre_l1', 'raw_intent', 'after_head', 'after_modulation', 'final_command'), or null for a block that is not a brain stage (retina, wave, pose, body).

sha256.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of exactly the bytes at [offset, offset+length) in neural.trace, i.e. this block's own on-disk bytes, independent of every other block. A decoder verifies this by default before returning a block's data (PRD S5, validation point 2: 'the loader ... checks every block's bytes against the manifest's block table ... before drawing anything').
